head_commit.message:
feat(departments): add Pulmonology + GI + Rheumatology + Orthopedics + Neurology + Stitch hub

Adds 5 backend dept modules + 6 frontend pages:

BACKEND (e51)
- pulmonology_router.js     Asthma (GINA 2024) + COPD (GOLD 2024)
- gi_router.js              GI bleed (Glasgow-Blatchford) + IBD (Mayo UC, CDAI Crohn)
- rheumatology_router.js    DAS28-CRP (RA), SLEDAI-2K (SLE)
- orthopedics_router.js     FRAX score (NOF 2022)
- neurology_router.js       NIHSS (stroke), APACHE IV (ICU)
- 7 new schemas (asthma, copd, gi-bleed, ibd, das28, frax, nihss)
- migrations/e51_*.sql adds 5 tables:
  pulmonology_assessments, gi_assessments, rheumatology_assessments,
  orthopedics_assessments, neurology_assessments
- All RLS + FORCE RLS + tenant policy

FRONTEND (Stitch token-saver)
- 5 dept pages (pulmonology, gi, rheumatology, orthopedics, neurology)
- public/departments/hub.html ΓÇö Navigation hub for all 14 dept modules
- All use shared tokens + API client

VERIFICATION
- 7 multispecialty tests PASS (Asthma partly-controlled, COPD GOLD staging,
  GI bleed high-severity, UC Mayo moderate, DAS28-CRP high disease activity,
  FRAX 70yo+prior fracture, NIHSS moderate stroke)
- 402 schemas (7 new)
- All routers wired in server.js after /api/obgyn
- All routes enforce: requireAuth + requireTenantScope + requireRole +
  validateBody + idempotencyGuard (writes)

Total feat/waveA-subagent now covers 14 clinical departments with 14
engines + 14 routers + 76+ pure-function tests + 15 Stitch frontend pages.

head_commit.message:
feat(departments): add Oncology + Nephrology + OBGYN engines, routers, migrations, Frontend Stitch pages

Adds 3 backend dept modules + 9 Stitch frontend pages:

BACKEND (e50)
- oncology_router.js     4 endpoints (tnm, bsa, chemo-dose, tnm-stages ref)
- nephrology_router.js   3 endpoints (ckd-stage, hd-adequacy, categories ref)
- obgyn_router.js        2 endpoints (partograph, bishop-score)
- 7 new schemas (TNM, BSA, chemo-dose, CKD stage, HD adequacy,
                partograph, bishop)
- migrations/e50_oncology_nephrology_obgyn_up.sql adds:
  oncology_staging, oncology_chemo_doses, nephrology_ckd_assessments,
  nephrology_hd_adequacy, obgyn_partograph

FRONTEND (Stitch token-saver)
- public/css/nama-tokens.css   Shared design tokens + base classes
- public/js/nama-api.js        Shared fetch client (apiGet/apiPost/apiPut/apiDel)
- public/js/nama-i18n.js       AR/EN locale loader + translator
- public/js/locales/ar.json    Arabic translations for 9 depts
- public/js/locales/en.json    English translations for 9 depts
- public/departments/cardiology.html    GRACE + Troponin forms
- public/departments/emergency.html     ESI triage form
- public/departments/endocrinology.html Glycemic + Thyroid forms
- public/departments/pediatrics.html    APGAR + Vitals forms
- public/departments/surgery.html       ASA + WHO timeout forms
- public/departments/pharmacy.html      Interactions + Renal-dose forms
- public/departments/oncology.html      TNM + Chemo forms
- public/departments/nephrology.html    CKD stage form
- public/departments/obgyn.html         Bishop form

DESIGN SYSTEM (shared tokens)
- Colors: primary/success/warning/danger/info
- Spacing: --nama-pad-sm/pad/pad-lg, --nama-radius
- Shadows: --nama-shadow, --nama-shadow-lg
- Typography: --nama-font-ar (Tajawal), --nama-font-en (Inter)
- Layout: --nama-max-w (1200px)
- WCAG AA: contrast ΓëÑ 4.5:1, keyboard nav, ARIA labels
- RTL/LTR: dir auto-switch, logical CSS properties

VERIFICATION
- 10 onc/neph/obgyn tests PASS (TNM stage IIIB+I, BSA 1.84,
  Paclitaxel dose, CKD eGFR + KDIGO, HD spKt/V, Partograph normal+abnormal,
  Bishop favorable)
- 388+ schemas (7 new)
- All routers wired in server.js after /api/pharmacy
- All routes enforce: requireAuth + requireTenantScope + requireRole +
  validateBody + idempotencyGuard (writes)

head_commit.message:
feat(departments): add Pediatrics + Surgery + Pharmacy engines, routers, migrations, schemas, tests

Adds 3 complete clinical modules:

PEDIATRICS
- pediatrics_engine.js   APGAR (1/5/10 min), age-adjusted vital signs,
                         Holliday-Segar fluid (4-2-1), Westley croup,
                         PEWS, Saudi MoH immunization schedule
- pediatrics_router.js   6 endpoints (apgar, vitals, fluid, croup, pews, immunizations)
- 3 new schemas (Fluid, Croup, PEWS)
- Apgar schema reuses pre-existing pediatricsApgarCreate

SURGERY (Perioperative)
- surgery_engine.js      ASA classification (1-6 + emergency),
                         NSQIP-simplified risk (mortality + morbidity),
                         WHO surgical safety checklist (sign_in/time_out/sign_out),
                         Caprini VTE score
- surgery_router.js      4 endpoints (asa, risk, timeout, caprini)
- 3 new schemas (Risk, Timeout, Caprini) ΓÇö Asa reuses pre-existing
- WHO timeout can return 409 if critical_block (missing patient_identity)
- migrations/e49_pediatrics_surgery_pharmacy_up.sql adds:
  pediatrics_apgar, surgery_asa_assessments, surgery_timeouts

PHARMACY
- pharmacy_engine.js     20 drug interactions (Lexicomp 2024),
                         Cockcroft-Gault CrCl + dose adjustment,
                         FDA pregnancy categories (PLRE 2014)
- pharmacy_router.js     3 endpoints (interactions, renal-dose, pregnancy-check)
- 3 new schemas

VERIFICATION
- 19 peds/surg/pharm tests PASS (APGAR, vitals, fluid, croup, PEWS,
  ASA, NSQIP, WHO timeout + critical_block, Caprini, drug interactions
  incl. contraindicated, Cockcroft-Gault, vanco dose reduction,
  warfarin pregnancy = X)
- 388 schemas total (9 new)
- All routers wired in server.js
- All routes enforce: requireAuth + requireTenantScope + requireRole +
  validateBody + idempotencyGuard (writes)

Co-Authored-By: GitHub Copilot <noreply@github.com>
